subject.title: Published versions are reserved but unavailable for inspection or discovery

question: After inspecting the two production records and stored artifacts, should ClawHub complete their interrupted publication or retire the incomplete reservations and permit clean exact-version republishes?
rationale: The repository alone cannot establish whether the reserved records contain complete, integrity-verified artifacts and acceptable moderation results; restoration affects the registry’s install and supply-chain trust boundary.

options.title: Validate and reconcile
options.body: Verify artifact integrity, ownership, publish-attempt state, and completed scans, then atomically restore every missing pointer and index only when all checks pass.

options.title: Retire and republish
options.body: If either record is incomplete or unverifiable, tombstone it with an audit trail and safely release the exact version number for a fresh authenticated publish.

recommendation.title: Validate and reconcile
recommendation.body: Verify artifact integrity, ownership, publish-attempt state, and completed scans, then atomically restore every missing pointer and index only when all checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: The closest history combines pending-version repair, artifact backup, deletion safety, and moderation-state maintenance.
